description: React component for the actions menu in Mattermost post interface, handling app bindings, plugin menu items, marketplace modal, and dropdown behavior.

classes.name: ActionMenuClass
classes.description: React component managing the actions menu for posts, including app bindings, plugin items, and marketplace interactions.

methods.name: fetchBindings
methods.description: Fetches app bindings for the post's channel and team if apps are enabled.

methods.name: onClickAppBinding
methods.description: Handles click events on app bindings, processing responses and opening modals or posting ephemeral messages.

methods.name: renderDivider
methods.description: Renders a divider element in the menu.

methods.name: handleDropdownOpened
methods.description: Handles the opening/closing of the dropdown, calculating whether to open upwards or downwards based on space.
